records.proposal: A card the owner has answered leaves the list of cards waiting for them at once, even before plumb has finished applying the answer; the panel groups cards by where they stand: waiting for you, being processed, blocked, done

Once the owner answers a card it no longer counts or shows as waiting, even before the answer is applied; the panel groups this session's cards as waiting for you, being processed, blocked (with the reason) and done
